Why Amoha

Amoha is Sanskrit. It means clarity, a mind free of illusion.

We chose the name because it is what we want to stand for: purity in our vision, clarity in our approach and integrity in everything we build. Every development is inspired by the natural world and planned to feel connected, purposeful and enduring.
